sentences.en: Yes. I can ask for directions to bars and brothels in another ten.

sentences.en: The fans won't be restricted to legalized brothels like the Pascha.

sentences.en: Single women were in short supply in the American West and in all the major towns had brothels.

sentences.en: There was concern in Germany and abroad about a surge in forced prostitution as new brothels opened to cope with the influx of fans.

sentences.en: Conrad has recently been involved with surveillance at brothels where there are child prostitutes.
sentences.vi: Conrad gần đây đã tham gia giám sát các nhà thổ nơi có gái mại dâm trẻ em.

sentences.en: It is done in all the brothels, and with these words Marya Dmitrievna, turning up her wide sleeves with her usual threatening gesture and glancing sternly round, moved across the room.
sentences.vi: Nó được thực hiện trong tất cả các nhà chứa, và với những lời này, Marya Dmitrievna, vén ống tay áo rộng lên với cử chỉ đe dọa thường ngày và liếc nhìn quanh một cách nghiêm nghị, di chuyển khắp phòng.
